Maria P: Heads-up — Priya Sharma's background check is 'Pending docs' in Checkr. They need employer contact info and copy of passport. She's starting Mon 3/30 and needs badge by EOD.
Alex (Facilities): We can run a courier 9-11am Mon. If pickup at 10 works I'll book.
Jamal - People Ops: Please add bg-intake@redwood.com and +1-555-2121 as employer contact in the portal. Also note we can accept scanned passport via secure upload link — but only <10MB.
Maria P: She tried to upload but got 'file too large'. Courier would be easiest. She can sign release form.
Alex (Facilities): Courier requires signed release. Use this snippet, paste into email:
```
I authorize Redwood Inference to pick up original ID documents from [address] on [date].
Name: Priya Sharma
Signature: __________________
```
:package:
Maria P: Sending release PDF now to priya and courier team. Priya — can you confirm pick-up address is 1234 Market St Apt 5B?
Priya S: Confirmed. 1234 Market St apt 5B. I can do 10am monday. Also question on benefits enrollment - do new hires get 30 days to enroll?
Jamal - People Ops: Yes, benefits window is 30 days from start. I'll DM you the benefits checklist and add you to the new-hire orientation invite.
Onboard Bot: Reminder — Badge pickup and welcome session scheduled Mon 3/30 2:00pm, meet at lobby. Link: https://tiny.redwood/welcome
Alex (Facilities): Courier booked for Mon 10:00. I'll add escort on site. Maria, tag me if the release is uploaded.
Maria P: Release uploaded to shared drive and copied into portal notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya S: Thanks!!
